name: relay
description: Discover and message the other Claude Code and Codex sessions running on this machine.
notes: This bridge needs no credentials. It reads the machine-local session registries
(~/.claude/sessions and ~/.codex) and shells out to already-authenticated CLIs.
Codex targets are queued with `codex queue`. Claude targets are relayed by a
`claude -p` delegate confined to the SendMessage tool.
Optional env: RELAY_SPOOL relocates the failure spool, default ~/.cross-agent-relay/spool.log. Use an absolute path in a private directory.
